description: Recall how Codex tool-use hooks route retrieval queries through Lint-AI.

setup_messages.prompt: Remember that Codex tool-use retrieval is handled by PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, and PostToolUse. The query should include turn_id, agent_id, agent_type, tool_name, permission_mode, trigger, reason, tool_input, and tool_response, while keeping excerpts bounded.

continuation_prompt: When Codex intercepts a tool call, which hook events retrieve memory, and which request fields are used to build the query? Keep the answer focused on the Codex adapter behavior.

expected_facts.description: PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, and PostToolUse all route through retrieval.
The retrieval query includes turn, agent, tool, permission, and tool payload fields.
Retrieved memories should be bounded excerpts, not complete records.

forbidden_facts.description: Tool-use hooks must not be described as unsupported or ignored.
